arguments.name: Showcase Asset Muse
arguments.description: Between-iteration muse for one showcase asset: design_muse on the filed references and the existing cast, then 3+ variants rendered side by side in the substrate, then a rubric grade. No asset enters a scene without it (D55).

arguments.name: asset
arguments.description: The asset's job in the script's resource vocabulary.

arguments.name: constraints
arguments.defaultValue: Five-role flat SVG on a black field; Seuss contour language; Midnight Gospel stipple shadows; identity pigments fixed; drawn on twos. Variants must sit between the filed references (v3/references/style-references.json) and the existing cast (Clawd, Codex, gadget, frame).
arguments.description: The style envelope the variants must stay inside.

args.seed_refs: The existing cast under media/showcase/src/library/cast and props: their silhouettes are the other end of the space a new asset must sit between.
